- [LLEX.8.2.2] **`=`** alone (not followed by `=`) is lexed as `=`, a token
  distinct from `==` ([LGRA.2.10.1]). It is not an operator. It binds a name to
  the expression after it, and only the productions that name it accept it:
  `const_decl` ([LGRA.4.1]), `let_binding` ([LGRA.6.1]), `capture_binding`
  ([LGRA.8.1]), `unit_inline` ([LUNI.4.3]) and `formula_line` ([LUNI.4.5]).
  The compiler must refuse a `=` anywhere else as a parse error.
